title: Unfold a phone holder and dock a phone
instruction: Unfold the phone holder and place the phone on it. Tilt the phone's screen at least 45 degrees above the tabletop and keep its lowest point more than 3 cm above the tabletop. Keep the holder and phone within 30 degrees of alignment with the red square. Release the phone so it rests on the holder.
context: This task prepares a foldable phone stand for hands-free viewing during video calls, following recipes, or watching videos.
setup: Fixed dual-arm YAM station; READY arms, open grippers; tabletop z=0.7475 m. Folded aluminum-look holder with rigid silicone pads: 80x80 mm base, 61x80x2 mm cradle, 54 mm arm, 171 g. Free iPhone 17 Pro, metal/glass appearance: 150x71.9x8.75 mm chassis, camera bump, 206 g; lying flat. Holder/phone XY=(0.30,+/-0.105) m, yaw -90 deg. Red paper tape: 120x120 mm inner square centered on holder, 8 mm strips. Initial hinge angles are zero. Exact poses and geometry are in the code and USD assets.
scoring: Score 1 if, within 180 seconds, the released phone rests on the holder, its screen is tilted at least 45 degrees above the tabletop, its lowest point is more than 3 cm above the tabletop, and both holder and phone yaw errors relative to the red square are at most 30 degrees. Otherwise score 0.
run_limit: 3,600 control steps at 20 Hz (180 simulated seconds), including 32 initial history steps. The scripted demo uses 30 Hz with the same 180-second limit.
reset_notes: Restore both arms to READY with open grippers, the holder to its folded pose and zero hinge angles, and the phone to its initial flat pose. Clear velocities, elapsed time and scoring history. Settle for 0.5 s before the scored episode. Seed 0; fixed layout, no object jitter.
fidelity: CPU PhysX TGS at 480 Hz; free 4-body holder with 3 passive friction hinges, no drives or world fixation. Rigid iPhone with simplified convex collisions; rigid silicone pads. Hinge friction is estimated. Native PhysX sleep contributes to the settled hold; stability while kept awake or disturbed is unvalidated. Tape is visual only. Expert uses simulated state; Dream sees 3 calibrated RGB cameras (640x360 resized to 320x176) and joint positions.
scores: Existing videos rescored: Dream-1 0.0 after 180 s; holder folded, phone on table. Scripted demo 1.0 at 125.233 s; phone tilt 49.312 deg and bottom height 40.672 mm, holder/phone yaw errors 0.297/0.687 deg.
